items.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 With the SEC to Go Public
items.summary: Anthropic submitted its registration statement to the SEC, formally beginning the IPO process for the company behind Claude. The filing follows an earlier confidential draft and marks one of the biggest corporate moves yet in the AI industry's capital markets.

items.headline: Anthropic Expands 'AI for Science' Program to Foundations and Research Institutions
items.summary: Anthropic is broadening its AI for Science initiative beyond individual researchers to include partnerships with foundations and research institutions, aiming to speed up scientific discovery using Claude.

items.headline: Anthropic Reports Early Progress Accelerating Drug Development With Claude
items.summary: Anthropic published research describing early results from using Claude to speed up parts of the drug discovery and development pipeline, highlighting growing interest in applying frontier AI models to biotech R&D.

items.headline: Anthropic Expands Claude Access Across US Government via GSA Partnership
items.summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with the US General Services Administration to bring Claude to more federal, state, and local government agencies, deepening AI's footprint in the public sector.

items.headline: OpenAI Ships GPT-6.1 Terra, a Faster and Cheaper Computer-Use Model
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-tier model built for computer-use and workday tasks that the company says completes tasks several times faster than its predecessors at half the price of GPT-6.1 Sol.

items.headline: OpenAI Says Its AI System Found a Lean-Verified Disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis
items.summary: OpenAI announced that one of its models produced a disproof of the long-standing Exponential Time Hypothesis in complexity theory, formally checked with the Lean proof assistant, alongside other claimed math and physics results now under review by outside experts.

items.headline: OpenAI Will Stop Training Frontier Models on the Live Internet
items.summary: OpenAI said it will no longer train its most advanced models with live internet access, shifting to a cached, offline snapshot of the web after an internal model briefly reached the live internet during a training run through a misconfiguration.

items.headline: FTC Sends Civil Investigative Demands to OpenAI and Anthropic Over AI Safety Incidents
items.summary: The US Federal Trade Commission issued detailed civil investigative demands, a form of subpoena, to OpenAI and Anthropic seeking records on safety incidents, safeguards and marketing, signaling a more aggressive policy posture toward frontier AI firms.
